items.sentence: During the period at issue, Complainant worked as a Biologist, GS-0401-11, until being promoted to GS-12 in [MASK], at the Agency’s National Institute on Aging, Laboratory of Neurogenetics ("Lab") Neuromuscular Disease Research Section (“Section”) in Bethesda, Maryland.

On [MASK], Complainant filed an EEO complaint, as amended, alleging that the Agency discriminated against her based on her race/color (African American/Black), national origin (Guyanese), sex (female), disability (diagnosed with bipolar disorder in 2009, but re- diagnosed with Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) in 2017, generalized anxiety disorder, benign mitral valve prolapse, and fibroid tumors requiring surgical removal in December 2013) and reprisal for prior protected EEO activity (initiating EEO counseling on July 27, 2017 on the instant EEO complaint) when: 1.
On or about [MASK], the Section Chief (“Section Chief”) (Ireland, Caucasian, male), who was her first line supervisor, did not conduct a scheduled meeting with her. 2.
On or about [MASK], Section Chief told her he changed her work assignment to making DNA plates, which is usually a role suitable for summer students not a biologist with a Ph.D. 3.
After initiating EEO counseling on [MASK], Agency management excluded her from a major project in her office/lab. 4.
